sources.name: The Moscow Times
sources.permissionNote: Official RSS feed listed on the publisher's own RSS page. Footer: '© The Moscow Times, all rights reserved'. No syndication licence: only the feed's headline and link are used to discover stories; Wartabiye TV writes its own Somali report with attribution and a direct link. Text and photos are never copied.

sources.name: The Local Italy
sources.permissionNote: Terms of use: 'You may not copy, modify, reproduce, republish ... any material from this site'; personal non-commercial use only. Headline and link are used only to discover the story; Wartabiye TV writes its own report from verified facts with attribution and a link. Nothing is copied or translated from the article. Many articles are for members only (paywall): never bypassed.

sources.name: DutchNews.nl
sources.permissionNote: DutchNews terms: commercial websites must contact editor@dutchnews.nl before using or syndicating its content; unauthorised use is invoiced. Wartabiye TV is advertising-supported, so NO headlines, links or text are collected or published until the owner has written permission. The 5-minute monitor only checks that the feed is reachable and how recent it is.

sources.name: ABC News (US)
sources.permissionNote: US ABC News (American Broadcasting Company, Disney), the official feeds listed on abcnews.go.com. ABC says it offers headlines by RSS 'to facilitate reading our stories via news aggregators'; content is under the Disney terms of use (all rights reserved). Only headline and link are used to discover the story; Wartabiye TV writes its own report with attribution and a link. Not the Australian ABC (abc.net.au).

sources.name: Sweden Herald
sources.permissionNote: '© 2026 Sweden Herald'; no syndication terms published. Part of its copy is translated from the Swedish news agency TT. Only headline and link are used to discover stories; Wartabiye TV writes its own report with attribution and a link. Photos (including CC-licensed Wikimedia ones on its pages) are not taken from the site.
